example_en: He stayed up late to review for the final exam last night.
example_cn: 昨晚他熬夜复习期末考试。
note: take a final 参加期末考试；final 也指决赛或结局。

example_en: This particular method works well only in small classes.
example_cn: 这种特定的方法只在小班教学中效果好。
note: in particular 尤其；this particular 后接名词，意为特定的。

example_en: The new policy has come under attack from local farmers.
example_cn: 这项新政策受到了当地农民的抨击。
note: come under attack 遭到抨击；an attack on 对某人的攻击。

example_en: Fresh air is particularly important for children growing up in cities.
example_cn: 新鲜空气对在城市里长大的孩子尤为重要。
note: particularly 常放 be 动词后、实义动词前，用于强调程度。

example_en: Officials announced on Monday that the company would open ten new stores.
example_cn: 该公司周一宣布将开设十家新门店。
note: announce that 从句最常见；announce a decision 宣布决定。

example_en: Good time management helps students balance study and part-time work.
example_cn: 良好的时间管理能帮助学生平衡学业与兼职。
note: time management 时间管理；under new management 由新管理层经营。

example_en: There is little evidence that the new drug actually works.
example_cn: 几乎没有证据表明这种新药确实有效。
note: evidence 不可数，用 a piece of evidence；也可接 that 从句。

example_en: Many young workers feel their voices are ignored in company decisions.
example_cn: 许多年轻员工觉得自己的声音在公司决策中被忽视了。
note: have a voice in 在……有发言权；raise one's voice 提高嗓门。

example_en: After three failed attempts, she finally passed the driving test.
example_cn: 三次失败之后，她终于通过了驾照考试。
note: finally 强调经过漫长过程后的结果，与 at last 相近。

example_en: Could you explain to me how this online payment system works?
example_cn: 你能给我解释一下这个在线支付系统是怎么运作的吗？
note: explain sth to sb，不能说 explain sb sth；也常接从句。

example_en: The total cost of the trip came to about two thousand yuan.
example_cn: 这次旅行的总花费大约是两千元。
note: in total 总共；a total of 后接数量，表示总计。

example_en: Shoppers here can find a wide range of products at reasonable prices.
example_cn: 这家店以合理的价格提供种类丰富的商品。
note: a wide range of 范围广泛；range from A to B 从……到……不等。

example_en: A healthy relationship between parents and children depends on honest talk.
example_cn: 父母与孩子之间的健康关系有赖于坦诚的交流。
note: relationship with sb 与某人的关系；也可说 between A and B。

example_en: The federal government promised more money for rural schools this year.
example_cn: 联邦政府承诺今年为农村学校提供更多资金。
note: federal government 联邦政府；在美国语境中与 state 相对。

example_en: Small differences in daily habits can lead to very different results.
example_cn: 日常习惯上的小小差异可能带来截然不同的结果。
note: make a difference 起作用；difference between A and B 指两者之差。

example_en: Recycling waste material reduces the pressure on land and water.
example_cn: 回收废弃材料能减轻土地和水资源承受的压力。
note: raw material 原材料；material 作形容词指物质的、重要的。

example_en: She is a model of patience for everyone in the department.
example_cn: 她是部门里每个人耐心方面的榜样。
note: a model of 是……的典范；role model 指供人学习的榜样。

example_en: Our class project on water pollution won first prize at the fair.
example_cn: 我们班关于水污染的项目在展评中获得了一等奖。
note: a project on 关于……的项目；carry out a project 实施项目。

example_en: Cycling is popular in this city, especially among young commuters.
example_cn: 骑自行车在这座城市很受欢迎，尤其是在年轻通勤者中。
note: especially 后接名词或介词短语，点出最突出的部分。

example_en: City parks give residents space to relax after a long working day.
example_cn: 城市公园为居民提供了漫长工作日之后放松的空间。
note: make space for 为……腾出空间；in space 指在太空中。

example_en: Students can apply the same method to other reading tasks.
example_cn: 学生可以把同样的方法应用到其他阅读任务上。
note: apply sth to sth 把……用于；apply for a job 申请工作。

example_en: A young couple opened a small bookshop near the university.
example_cn: 一对年轻夫妇在大学附近开了一家小书店。
note: a couple of 两三个，口语常用；the couple 指夫妻二人。

example_en: The task was harder than we expected; indeed, it took two weeks.
example_cn: 这项任务比我们预想的难，确实花了两周时间。
note: indeed 可加强语气，也可置于句首表示进一步说明。

example_en: Online courses vary greatly in quality, so read reviews before choosing.
example_cn: 网络课程质量差别很大，选择前请先看评价。
note: vary in quality 质量参差；quality of life 生活质量。

example_en: She will present her research at an international conference in May.
example_cn: 她将在五月的一个国际会议上展示自己的研究。
note: attend a conference 出席会议；press conference 新闻发布会。

example_en: Spending time in nature helps children develop patience and curiosity.
example_cn: 在大自然中度过时光有助于孩子培养耐心与好奇心。
note: by nature 天生地；in nature 指在自然界中，注意区分。

example_en: Repeated advertising slowly improved the brand's image among young customers.
example_cn: 这则广告改善了该品牌在年轻顾客中的形象。
note: public image 公众形象；improve one's image 改善形象。

example_en: Many students check their phones within minutes of waking up.
example_cn: 许多学生醒来没几分钟就去看手机。
note: check one's phone 看手机；phone 作动词表示打电话。

example_en: The structure of the essay is clear, but the examples are weak.
example_cn: 这篇文章结构清晰，但例子不够有力。
note: the structure of ……的结构；structure 也可指建筑物。

example_en: This new drink contains less sugar than the old version.
example_cn: 这款新饮料比旧配方的含糖量更低。
note: contain 指容器中含有的成分；contain oneself 表示克制情绪。

example_en: Researchers used a simple method to measure air quality in classrooms.
example_cn: 研究人员用一种简单的方法测量教室里的空气质量。
note: a method of doing sth 做某事的方法；比 way 更正式。

example_en: Thanks to the environmental movement, companies now treat plastic waste differently.
example_cn: 环保运动改变了企业处理塑料垃圾的方式。
note: social movement 社会运动；movement 也可指动作或乐章。

example_en: Please describe the process in detail so others can repeat it.
example_cn: 请详细描述这一过程，以便他人能够重复操作。
note: in detail 详细地；detailed 是形容词，意为详细的。

example_en: Walking to school every day can reduce both traffic and stress.
example_cn: 每天步行上学既能缓解交通，也能减轻压力。
note: reduce sth by 20% 减少两成；reduce the risk 降低风险。

example_en: A personal diary can help you clear your mind after a busy day.
example_cn: 忙碌一天之后，私人日记能帮你理清思绪。
note: personal experience 亲身经历；personally 意为就本人而言。

example_en: The two schools established a partnership to share teaching resources.
example_cn: 这两所学校建立了合作关系，以共享教学资源。
note: establish a partnership 建立合作；也可接 that 从句表示证实。

example_en: Watching a movie in English improves listening more than reading subtitles.
example_cn: 看英文电影对听力的提升胜过只读字幕。
note: watch a movie 看电影；movie 多为美式，film 偏英式。

example_en: Parents should respect their children's private space as they grow up.
example_cn: 孩子成长过程中，父母应当尊重他们的私人空间。
note: in private 私下地；private school 指私立学校。

example_en: A practical approach to saving energy is to switch off unused lights.
example_cn: 节约能源的一个可行做法是关掉不用的灯。
note: an approach to doing sth 做某事的方法，to 是介词。

example_en: The quiet village offered her a rare moment of peace.
example_cn: 这座安静的村庄给了她难得的片刻安宁。
note: in peace 安静地；peace of mind 指内心的平静。

example_en: A large amount of time is wasted on meaningless meetings.
example_cn: 大量时间被浪费在毫无意义的会议上。
note: a large amount of 修饰不可数名词；amount to 总计为。

example_en: Modern technology allows farmers to check soil moisture from their phones.
example_cn: 现代技术让农民能用手机查看土壤湿度。
note: information technology 信息技术；technology 也可指某项具体技术。

example_en: Under the new recycling scheme, green households receive small rewards.
example_cn: 该市推出了一项奖励绿色家庭的回收方案。
note: a recycling scheme 回收方案；美式英语常用 program。

example_en: She received an award for her volunteer work in the community.
example_cn: 她因在社区的志愿服务而获得了奖项。
note: win an award 获奖；award sb sth 授予某人某物。

example_en: Pay close attention to the tone of the writer in this passage.
example_cn: 请密切关注这篇文章中作者的语气。
note: pay attention to 后接名词或动名词；attract attention 引起注意。

example_en: With steady practice, most learners achieve their goals within a year.
example_cn: 通过持续练习，大多数学习者能在一年内实现目标。
note: achieve a goal 实现目标；achieve success 取得成功。

example_en: Chapter one explains why sleep matters so much for memory.
example_cn: 第一章解释了睡眠为何对记忆很重要。
note: chapter one 第一章；chapter 也可喻指人生或历史的阶段。

example_en: More graduates choose to work in smaller cities than before.
example_cn: 如今选择去小城市工作的毕业生比过去更多。
note: choose to do sth 决定做某事；choose between A and B 二选一。

example_en: A local organization helps elderly people learn to use smartphones.
example_cn: 一家当地组织帮助老年人学会使用智能手机。
note: non-profit organization 非营利组织；organization 指组织、机构。

example_en: No experiment has yet confirmed this theory, though it sounds reasonable.
example_cn: 这个理论听起来合理，但还没有实验证实。
note: in theory 理论上；theory 常与 practice 对照使用。

example_en: The family sold some property to pay for their daughter's education.
example_cn: 这家人卖掉一些财产来支付女儿的教育费用。
note: property 表财产时不可数；也可指房产、物业。

example_en: Solar energy is a clean source of power for remote villages.
example_cn: 太阳能是偏远村庄的一种清洁能源来源。
note: a source of ……的来源；source of information 信息来源。

example_en: Her direct way of speaking sometimes upsets new colleagues.
example_cn: 她说话直接的方式有时会让新同事不舒服。
note: direct flight 直达航班；direct 作动词意为指导、导演。

example_en: The factory doubled its production after installing new machines.
example_cn: 安装新机器后，这家工厂的产量翻了一番。
note: mass production 批量生产；production line 生产线。

example_en: After a long debate, the board approved the new library plan.
example_cn: 董事会批准了新建图书馆的计划。
note: on board 在船或飞机上；board 指董事会时作整体看。

example_en: Food tells you more about a culture than any guidebook can.
example_cn: 饮食比任何旅行指南都更能说明一种文化。
note: cultural 是形容词；culture 也可指企业文化、修养。

example_en: The press reported the story before the official statement appeared.
example_cn: 官方声明还未发布，新闻界就已经报道了此事。
note: the press 指新闻界；press the button 意为按下按钮。

example_en: Renewable energy now supplies a third of the country's electricity.
example_cn: 可再生能源目前供应全国三分之一的电力。
note: renewable energy 可再生能源；full of energy 精力充沛。

example_en: I didn't realize how much time I had wasted until the exam.
example_cn: 直到考试我才意识到自己浪费了多少时间。
note: realize that 从句最常用；realize a dream 实现梦想。

example_en: Volunteering abroad gave him the opportunity to practice French.
example_cn: 在海外做志愿者让他有了练习法语的机会。
note: an opportunity to do sth；take the opportunity to do 趁机做。

example_en: Few workers know how to operate the new printing machine.
example_cn: 很少有工人知道如何操作这台新印刷机。
note: operate a machine 操作机器；operate on sb 给某人做手术。

example_en: Read the contract carefully before you sign anything.
example_cn: 签字之前请仔细阅读合同。
note: sign a contract 签合同；contract 作动词可指收缩、感染。

example_en: For many students, the choice of major shapes their whole career.
example_cn: 对很多学生来说，专业的选择会影响整个职业生涯。
note: have no choice but to do 只能做；by choice 出于自愿。

example_en: Most traffic accidents occur at crossings during the evening rush.
example_cn: 大多数交通事故发生在晚高峰的十字路口。
note: occur to sb 指某人想到；occur 无被动语态。

example_en: In ten years the city's population has grown by nearly 20 percent.
example_cn: 十年间，这座城市的人口增长了近两成。
note: population 作主语时谓语常用单数；aging population 老龄人口。

example_en: Various studies suggest that morning exercise improves concentration.
example_cn: 多项研究表明，晨间锻炼能提高注意力。
note: various 修饰复数名词；vary 是动词，意为变化。

example_en: This chart represents the average rainfall in five major cities.
example_cn: 这张图表显示了五个主要城市的平均降雨量。
note: represent 可指代表、象征，也指图表中所表示的数值。

example_en: Free medical care for children has eased pressure on poor families.
example_cn: 儿童免费医疗减轻了贫困家庭的负担。
note: medical care 医疗服务；medical school 医学院。

example_en: Students must complete all four tasks within ninety minutes.
example_cn: 学生必须在九十分钟内完成全部四项任务。
note: complete a task 完成任务；complete 作形容词意为完全的。

example_en: Living standards in the countryside have risen steadily since 2010.
example_cn: 自 2010 年以来，农村的生活水平稳步提高。
note: living standard 生活水平；up to standard 达到标准。

example_en: The purpose of the survey was to find out how students read.
example_cn: 这项调查的目的是了解学生的阅读方式。
note: on purpose 故意地；for the purpose of 为了……目的。

example_en: Regular exercise brings lasting benefits to both body and mind.
example_cn: 规律锻炼对身心都有持久的益处。
note: benefit from 从……中受益；benefit sb 使某人受益。

example_en: Living alone made her more independent and better at planning.
example_cn: 独自生活让她更独立，也更善于做计划。
note: be independent of 不依赖；independent study 自主学习。

example_en: Cost is not the only factor students consider when choosing a school.
example_cn: 费用并不是学生择校时考虑的唯一因素。
note: a key factor in ……的关键因素；factor 后常接 in。

example_en: His answer proved that he had read the whole report.
example_cn: 他的回答证明他读完了整份报告。
note: prove to be 结果是；prove that 从句意为证实。

example_en: Some economists argue that higher wages reduce long-term unemployment.
example_cn: 一些经济学家认为，提高工资会减少长期失业。
note: argue with sb 与某人争辩；argue for 支持，argue against 反对。

example_en: Her performance in the interview impressed the whole selection team.
example_cn: 她在面试中的表现让整个选拔团队印象深刻。
note: academic performance 学业表现；give a performance 演出。

example_en: Sleeping late follows a pattern that is hard to break.
example_cn: 晚睡是一种很难打破的习惯模式。
note: a pattern of ……的模式；behavior pattern 行为模式。

example_en: The royal family opened part of the palace to the public.
example_cn: 王室将宫殿的一部分向公众开放。
note: the royal family 王室；royal 通常只作定语。

example_en: The author argues that cities should protect their old streets.
example_cn: 作者主张城市应当保护自己的老街。
note: the author of ……的作者；author 与 writer 都可指作者。

example_en: The focus of the debate shifted from cost to safety.
example_cn: 争论的焦点从成本转向了安全。
note: focus on 专注于；the focus of attention 关注的焦点。

example_en: Basic knowledge of first aid can save a life in an emergency.
example_cn: 基础的急救知识能在紧急时刻挽救生命。
note: knowledge 不可数，说 a piece of knowledge；to my knowledge 据我所知。

example_en: It is safe to donate blood, and the process takes ten minutes.
example_cn: 献血是安全的，整个过程只需十分钟。
note: donate blood 献血；blood pressure 血压。

example_en: A travel agency arranged the flights and hotels for the group.
example_cn: 一家旅行社为这个团队安排了机票和酒店。
note: news agency 通讯社；agency 指提供服务的机构。

example_en: Trust is the basis of any long-term partnership between companies.
example_cn: 信任是公司之间任何长期合作的基础。
note: on the basis of 根据；on a regular basis 定期地。

example_en: Last term the school introduced a new course on digital media.
example_cn: 学校上学期开设了一门数字媒体的新课程。
note: introduce A to B 把 A 介绍给 B；introduce 也指推行。

example_en: Recently, more companies have started offering flexible working hours.
example_cn: 最近，越来越多的公司开始提供弹性工作时间。
note: recently 常与现在完成时连用，也可置于句中。

example_en: The library runs a series of free lectures on modern art.
example_cn: 图书馆举办一系列关于现代艺术的免费讲座。
note: a series of 一系列；谓语单复数看 of 后的名词。

example_en: Children need a quiet environment to concentrate on difficult tasks.
example_cn: 孩子们需要一个安静的环境来专注于难题。
note: protect the environment 保护环境；working environment 工作环境。

example_en: The success of the campaign depended on thousands of small donors.
example_cn: 这场运动的成功依赖于成千上万的小额捐款者。
note: the key to success 成功的关键；succeed in doing 成功做某事。

example_en: Women are entering careers that were once closed to them.
example_cn: 越来越多的女性正进入过去对她们关闭的职业领域。
note: enter 后直接跟名词，不加 into；enter into 表示开始讨论。

example_en: Natural light in classrooms improves both mood and attention span.
example_cn: 教室里的自然光既能改善情绪，也能延长注意力时间。
note: natural resources 自然资源；it is natural to do 很正常。

example_en: Please ensure that all windows are closed before you leave.
example_cn: 离开前请确保所有窗户都已关好。
note: ensure that 从句或 ensure + 名词；不能说 ensure sb to do。

example_en: This region is famous for its tea and mild climate.
example_cn: 这个地区以茶叶和温和的气候著称。
note: in the region of 大约；regional 是形容词，指地区的。

example_en: The company issued a short statement denying the rumours.
example_cn: 该公司发布了一份简短声明，否认了传闻。
note: issue a statement 发表声明；make a statement 作出陈述。

example_en: The relation between income and health has been widely studied.
example_cn: 收入与健康之间的关系已被广泛研究。
note: in relation to 关于；relationship 更强调人际联系。

example_en: There has been a significant drop in plastic waste this year.
example_cn: 今年塑料垃圾明显减少。
note: a significant change 显著变化；也可指意味深长的。

example_en: She refused the offer as a matter of principle.
example_cn: 出于原则，她拒绝了这份邀约。
note: as a matter of principle 出于原则；in principle 原则上。

example_en: The school's response to parents' concerns was quick and clear.
example_cn: 学校对家长关切作出的回应迅速而明确。
note: in response to 作为对……的回应；比 answer 更正式。

example_en: Over the past decade, online shopping has changed how we buy food.
example_cn: 过去十年间，网上购物改变了我们购买食物的方式。
note: over the past decade 过去十年；decades of 数十年的。
